description: Move a ticket forward one step at a time: unprioritized → prioritized → started → finished → delivered. Give a ticket points with update_ticket before starting it. Finished is the last step you take on your own; deliver only when the person asks. Cancelled is reachable from any open state and needs a resolution. To move a ticket back to the Icebox or the Backlog, tell the person where it is going, then use update_ticket with state. Accepting or rejecting is a person's decision, made in the app, so this tool offers neither.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID, as list_workspaces gives it. Defaults to the one workspace this connection reaches; required when it reaches several.
